sections.title: Vision & mission
sections.visionBody: To deliver reliable, coordinated MEP and fire engineering that helps clients build safer, more efficient facilities — from concept through construction documentation.
sections.missionBody: We provide professional design services, clear technical communication, and responsive coordination with architects, contractors, and authorities so projects move forward with confidence.

sections.title: MEP & fire design partner
sections.lead: Envir Consultancy supports developers, architects, and contractors with specialist engineering for building services and life-safety systems.
paragraphs: Our work spans load calculations, routing and riser strategy, equipment selection, and fire-fighting system layouts that integrate with architectural and structural constraints.
We aim for concise deliverables, review cycles that respect site deadlines, and documentation suitable for tender and authority submission.
highlights: Fire detection, alarm, and suppression coordination

sections.title: Core services
sections.subtitle: Integrated building services design for residential, commercial, and industrial projects.

items.title: Mechanical (HVAC)
items.description: Ventilation strategy, heating and cooling loads, duct routing, and plant room coordination.

items.title: Electrical
items.description: Power distribution, lighting design support, and panel schedules aligned with load requirements.

items.title: Plumbing
items.description: Water supply, sanitary layouts, and drainage coordination with architecture and structure.

items.title: Fire fighting & life safety
items.description: Sprinkler/hydrant routing concepts, fire pump requirements, and interface with fire alarm design.

sections.title: About us
body: We operate as engineering consultants in the construction industry, bridging design intent with executable MEP and fire packages.
Our team collaborates closely with project stakeholders to reduce clashes, clarify specifications, and maintain a single coordinated services narrative across disciplines.

details.description:
Concept-stage MEP coordination for a high-rise core and shell programme. Work included riser strategy, HVAC zoning assumptions, and electrical load blocks for landlord and tenant fit-out splits.

Deliverables focused on clash reduction with architecture and structure prior to tender.
